_comment: Lasting injuries (game/injuries.py). ALL PLACEHOLDERS. A creature's hit can injure: any hit with chance small_hit (v0.48.0, user: injuries more likely across the board), or, when it takes at least big_hit (a share of max HP, but never more than big_hit_cap damage) in one blow: the chance is chance + per_tier x (the creature's tier - 1). The injury is picked from those whose min_tier is at most the creature's tier, plus any the creature lists under 'injures' in monsters.json (creature_only injuries come only that way). Effects: attributes (added to the Hunter's attributes; a lower Fortitude also lowers max HP), max_hp, accuracy (melee), ranged (bows), evasion, damage (melee), dot (damage over time: 'damage' HP every 'every' turns for 'turns' turns; natural healing stops meanwhile; it doesn't tick in the city). minor injuries mend on their own after 'mends' Pulses; serious ones (mends null) need the healer. fee: what the healer charges to treat it. sight (optional): change to how far you can see, in cells (e.g. -3); it also limits the look cursor. No injury uses it yet.
